incidente.resumo: On September 13, 2022, read-only Google Cloud Filestore API access (List, GetOperation, from Console, gcloud and API) was unavailable globally for 3 hours 12 minutes, with ListInstances requests failing with error 429; mutate operations still succeeded. An internal Google service malfunctioned and overloaded the Filestore API, triggering its global request limit. The issue was resolved when engineers shut down the internal service.
servicos_afetados: Google Cloud Filestore API (read-only requests via Console, gcloud and API)

descricao.texto: Engineers were alerted through automated alerts on September 13, 2022 at 07:47 US/Pacific.
trechos: Our engineers were alerted of the issue through automated alerts on Tuesday, 13 September 2022 07:47 US/Pacific.

gatilho.texto: An internal Google service managing a large number of GCP projects malfunctioned and overloaded the Filestore API with requests.
trechos: The outage was triggered when an internal Google service managing a large number of GCP projects malfunctioned and overloaded the Filestore API with requests, causing global throttling of the Filestore API.

descricao.texto: Filestore enforces a global limit on API requests; the overload from one internal service caused global throttling, so read-only API access was unavailable for all customers in all locations.
trechos: Filestore enforces a global limit on API requests to limit impact in overload scenarios.

The outage was triggered when an internal Google service managing a large number of GCP projects malfunctioned and overloaded the Filestore API with requests, causing global throttling of the Filestore API.
As a result of this throttling, read-only API access was unavailable for all customers.
This affected customers in all locations, due to a global quota that applies to Filestore.

passos.texto: Once the nature and scope of the issue became clear, engineers started shutting down the internal service overloading the API at 10:33; the issue was completely resolved at 10:42.
trechos: Once the nature and scope of the issue became clear, Google engineers started shutting down the internal service overloading our APIs at 10:33 and the issue was completely resolved at 10:42.

acoes.texto: Google states it is committed to preventing recurrence by implementing action items, but the extracted text does not list them.
trechos: Google is committed to preventing recurrence by implementing the following action items:
resulted in all read-only API requests failing for a period of 3 hours, 12 minutes.

observacoes: The text announces 'the following action items:' but no items follow in the extracted text (likely lost in extraction). The mini report gives 3 hours 04 minutes (from 07:38); the final report's 3 hours 12 minutes was used.
